brief.headline: Increase in reports of intrusive advertisement formats
brief.happening: Users are reporting a rise in unskippable, full-screen, and video advertisements. These ads are described as disruptive to the core experience, particularly when appearing during app launch or while posting reviews.
brief.where_to_look: The app launch sequence and the movie logging flow.
brief.action: Review the frequency and placement of full-screen video ad units in recent builds.
brief.reply: Thank you for being a part of the Letterboxd community. We are sorry to hear that the recent changes to our ad experience have impacted your enjoyment of the app. We appreciate your feedback regarding the visibility of ads and will share this with our product team.

brief.headline: Navigation and display scaling concerns
brief.happening: Users report difficulty navigating the interface and finding specific sections like likes or following. There are also recurring reports regarding poor scaling and lack of support for iPhone Duo displays.
brief.where_to_look: The display scaling logic for foldable devices and the navigation menu structure.
brief.action: Review the recent impact of UI animations and audio behavior on app stability.
brief.reply: Thank you for sharing this feedback. We understand that the refresh animation can be disruptive, and we appreciate you highlighting this as an accessibility concern. Please feel free to reach out to our support team to share more details.

brief.headline: Stability and performance issues in recent app versions
brief.happening: Users are reporting frequent app crashes, long loading times, and content loading failures. Specific reports also mention video streaming interruptions and device overheating during use.
brief.where_to_look: The video playback and streaming functionality.
brief.action: Review recent crash logs and performance metrics for v4.13.10 and v4.13.12.
brief.reply: We are sorry to hear about the connection issues you experienced while watching. We want the video store to be a seamless experience for you. Please reach out to our support team so we can look into this further.

brief.headline: Decreasing reports of login and session sync issues
brief.happening: A small minority of recent reviews mention being randomly logged out or unable to sign in. Users have reported losing access to lists and reviews after being signed out unexpectedly.
brief.where_to_look: The authentication flow and session persistence during active app use.
brief.action: Review recent error logs related to session timeouts and account creation failures.
brief.reply: We are sorry to hear you're having trouble creating an account. Please reach out to our support team so we can look into this further and help you get started with Letterboxd.

brief.headline: Feature Gaps/Enhancements: raised mostly in happy reviews
brief.happening: Of the 26 reviews in the last 90 days that raise this, 21 are 4–5 stars and 1 is 1–2 stars: it comes up mostly as a request or a side note from people who like the app. The evidence below shows the unhappy one.
brief.where_to_look: The mobile app feature parity with the web browser.
brief.action: Review the feasibility of bringing web-only toggles to the mobile interface.
brief.reply: Thank you for being a paid member and for sharing this feedback. We understand how important the 'where to watch' toggle is for your mobile experience. We appreciate you bringing this to our attention, and please feel free to reach out to our support team with any other thoughts.
